name: electron-claude-agent
description: Electron + Claude Agent SDK：窗口点按钮跑通 query（Skill / Bash），支持 macOS & Windows 打包
author: xuanwenjing

scripts.dev: npm run python:fetch && npm run build:ts && npm run renderer:build && npm run ext:build && concurrently -k "tsc -p tsconfig.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "vite build --watch --config src/renderer/vite.config.mts" "wait-on dist/main/index.js dist/renderer/index.html && npm run start:electron"
scripts.build:ts: node scripts/clean-main-build.cjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test scripts/build-output.test.cjs
scripts.build: node scripts/fetch-python.js current win-x64 && npm run build:ts && npm run renderer:build && npm run ext:build && electron-builder --mac --win nsis:x64
scripts.build:mac: node scripts/fetch-python.js current && npm run build:ts && npm run renderer:build && npm run ext:build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:win: node scripts/fetch-python.js win-x64 && npm run build:ts && npm run renderer:build && npm run ext:build && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.release:mac: node scripts/fetch-python.js current && npm run build:ts && npm run renderer:build && npm run ext:build && electron-builder --mac --publish always
scripts.release:win: node scripts/fetch-python.js win-x64 && npm run build:ts && npm run renderer:build && npm run ext:build && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish always
scripts.start: npm run python:fetch && npm run build:ts && npm run renderer:build && npm run ext:build && npm run start:electron
